published and working papers. Small files are hosted here or on GitHub; larger
archives live on a permanent repository with a DOI.

<div class="section-label">Replication packages</div>

<div class="paper-card">
  <h3>Fences and Fortunes — El Paso border enforcement</h3>
  <div class="meta">County panel + IPUMS extraction code · Stata</div>
  <p class="abstract">
    Annual county-level panel (per-capita income, population, business
    establishments, UCR crime) for El Paso and donor counties, 1977–2002, with
    the Stata code that produces every table and figure in the paper. The IPUMS
    Census microdata cannot be redistributed; we provide the extract definition
    and processing code instead.
  </p>
  <div class="paper-links">
    <a href="#">GitHub — coming soon</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="paper-card">
  <h3>Libyan Revolution — conflict events and mobile coverage</h3>
  <div class="meta">Geocoded events + network blackout dates · Stata/R</div>
  <p class="abstract">
    Geocoded collective-violence events from the 2011 Libyan Revolution matched
    to mobile-network coverage, including the regime blackout windows used for
    identification.
  </p>
  <div class="paper-links">
    <a href="#">Coming soon</a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="section-label">Constructed datasets</div>

<div class="paper-card">
  <h3>Los Angeles school quality panel</h3>
  <div class="meta">Scraped GreatSchools ratings · R</div>
